## Central question

How can financial data be made traceable, consistent, and easy to use in research?

## Problem and scope

Define the datasets and analysis workflows before choosing an implementation. The pipeline has not yet been built.

## Architecture plan

Separate source ingestion, raw storage, validation, normalization, and curated datasets.

## Reliability plan

Check duplicate records, missing timestamps, schema changes, units, and corporate-action handling. Preserve lineage and ingestion logs.

## Delivery plan

Document setup, data permissions, usage examples, failure handling, and meaningful tests. Add a code repository when implementation begins.

## Status

Implementation, tests, and benchmarks are pending.
